newsitem.title: ITALY: FORECAST-Italy seen issuing 15 trln lire BTP/CCTs.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST-Italy seen issuing 15 trln lire BTP/CCTs.

text.p: The Italian Treasury is expected to issue on average 15.0 trillion lire worth of fixed-rate government bonds (BTP) and floating-rate certificates (CCT) at its end-month auction, analysts polled by Reuters said.
Estimates ranged from 12.0 to 17.0 trillion lire worth of paper to be offered at the April 29 and 30 auctions, against 8.0 trillion lire of CCTs and 11.5 trillion lire of five-year BTPs falling due.
Payment is also due on CCT coupons for nearly 5.0 trillion and BPT coupons for over 5.0 trillion lire.
The Treasury has announced that on April 29 it will offer a new May 1, 2004 CCT whose coupon will be based of today's BOT auction.

Also on April 29, the Treasury will reopen the 10 and 30-year BTPs which were offered at the last auction, with a 13th tranche of the 6.75 percent February 1, 2007 BTP and a seventh tranche of the 7.25 percent November 1, 2026 BTP.
At the April 30 auction, the Treasury will offer an 11th tranche of the 6.0 percent February 15, 2000 BTP and a ninth tranche of the 6.25 percent March 1, 2002 BTP.
